definitions.explanation: A wide range or assortment of different types or kinds.
A television program featuring a mix of comedy, talk, games, music, and other entertainment segments. Variety shows are a major genre of Japanese television.

examples.japanese: バラエティ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}んだ→富む：12343_tomu⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a menu rich in variety.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧バラエティ⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な⟦{品揃|しなぞろ}え→品揃え：11844_shinazoroe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧だ。
examples.english: The charm of this store is its diverse selection.

examples.japanese: バラエティ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}んだ→富む：12343_tomu⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦{役|やく}に{立|た}つ→役に立つ：01130_yakunitatsu⟧だろう。
examples.english: A variety of experiences will be useful in the future.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧バラエティ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ている→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watch variety shows every week.

examples.english: Recent variety shows are often in quiz or talk-show format.

notes:
USAGE: バラエティ is a loanword from English "variety" with two common uses.

Sense 1 (variety): Often used in the set phrase バラエティ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧ (to be rich in variety) or バラエティ⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な (diverse, varied).

Sense 2 (variety show): バラエティ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧ is a staple of Japanese television. These shows feature comedians (⟦{芸人|げいにん}→芸人：13958_geinin⟧), celebrities (⟦タレント→タレント：25367_tarento⟧), and other entertainers in comedy skits, talk segments, quizzes, and games. Often shortened to just バラエティ when the context is clear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- バラエティ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{富|と}む→富む：12343_tomu⟧ (to be rich in variety)
- バラエティ⟦{豊|ゆた}か→豊か：03654_yutaka⟧な (diverse, varied)
- バラエティ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧ (variety show)
- バラエティ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to appear on a variety show)
